verdict.rationale: Parsec's pricing page lists "Virtual monitors" as a professional feature and claims multi-monitor streaming of up to 3 displays, so the host can create virtual displays. These are one-line feature mentions only, with nothing on how they work. Missing for 10: documentation on creating and configuring virtual displays, evidence that streamed content keeps rendering when windows are covered or the host runs headless with no physical monitor, plan or OS limitations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
